description: This file defines the 'LogNode' interface, which is a core component in a logging system. It declares a method for outputting log data, supporting the chaining of log nodes for flexible log processing and filtering.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging node that can output log data and chain to subsequent log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to instruct the first LogNode in the chain to output a log message, including optional Throwable information.
